heading: Marine Corps Reserve Policy Board
lead: A Marine Corps Reserve Policy Board shall be convened at least once annually at the seat of government to consider, recommend, and report to the Secretary of the Navy on reserve policy matters. At least half of the members of the Board must be officers of the Marine Corps Reserve.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: Provisions similar to those in this section were contained in section 5252(c) of this title, prior to repeal by Pub. L. 103–337, § 1661(a)(3)(A).

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective Dec. 1, 1994, except as otherwise provided, see section 1691 of Pub. L. 103–337, set out as a note under section 10001 of this title.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 103–337, div. A, title XVI, § 1661(b)(1), Oct. 5, 1994, 108 Stat. 2981.)
